title: Groombar | Top-Rated 5-Star Mobile & Salon Pet Grooming

facts.fact: Groombar's homepage claims it is a top-rated 5-star pet grooming provider, but the page gives no rating count, source, or date for this claim.
Groombar's vendor states it is trusted by thousands of pet parents nationwide, with no specific customer count given.
facts.quote: trusted by thousands of pet parents nationwide.

facts.fact: Groombar is a member of the EarthWise Pet family of brands, which the page lists as including Dee-O-Gee, Pet Depot, and more.
facts.quote: Groombar is a proud member of the EarthWise Pet family of brands, which includes Dee-O-Gee, Pet Depot, and more.

facts.fact: Groombar's Mobile Dog Grooming service, per the vendor, includes a full bath, haircut, nail trim, ear cleaning, and more in one visit.
facts.quote: Full bath, haircut, nail trim, ear cleaning, and more — all in one convenient visit.

facts.fact: Groombar's Self-Wash service provides the shampoo, towels, and aprons for customers who wash their own pets.
facts.quote: Everything you need — we provide the shampoo, towels, and aprons.

facts.fact: Groombar says add-on services such as teeth brushing, blueberry facials, and de-shedding treatments are available only at select locations.
Groombar states that services and availability vary by location and advises customers to call ahead to confirm their pet's needs.
facts.quote: Services and availability vary by location — please call ahead to confirm your pet's specific needs.

facts.fact: Groombar states that most of its locations are locally owned and operated.
facts.quote: Most Groombar locations are locally owned and operated.

facts.fact: Groombar's franchise page states that franchising is offered through EarthWise Pet, and that investment requirements and available territories are described on EarthWise Pet's franchising page rather than on this page.
facts.quote: Franchising opportunities with Groombar are offered through EarthWise Pet. Visit their franchising page to learn about investment requirements, available territories, and next steps.

facts.fact: Groombar's vendor lists exclusive territory rights in a franchisee's market as a franchise benefit, with no territory size or terms given.
facts.quote: Exclusive territory rights in your market

facts.fact: Groombar's vendor claims that mobile units eliminate brick-and-mortar costs for franchisees, without quantifying the savings.
facts.quote: Low overhead — mobile units eliminate brick-and-mortar costs

facts.fact: Groombar's vendor describes the pet care industry as one of the most recession-resistant markets in the USA, without citing a source or data.
facts.quote: The pet care industry is one of the most recession-resistant markets in the USA.
